verdict.rationale: The pack has no documentation of an audit-log feature, tamper-evidence, or any streaming or export path to a SIEM. The homepage activity-feed visual ("Johncreated a session… Mikeenabled 2FA") is an unexplained marketing mock-up, not a documented capability. The "Security & observability" line covers bot detection, IP blocking and email validation, which are adjacent controls rather than audit logging.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can capture tamper-evident audit logs of authentication and admin activity and stream or export them to my SIEM
